02
About the store

Understanding Color Blaze

Color Blaze supplies vibrant, non-toxic color powder across the United States for color runs, schools, fundraisers, Holi festivals and gender reveals. Many buyers are organisers ordering in bulk for a fixed date, so they value quick answers about quantities and delivery, clear tiered offers, and an easy way to find the right colours and pack sizes. Every app in the journey plays a part in that experience, which is why we reviewed them together rather than one by one.

Costs · Current plans and published pricing

What the current apps cost, and how that changes

Two apps are on paid plans today: Kaching Cart and Vify Order Printer. The others are free, but each free plan has limits. As the store grows, Kaching Cart moves to a higher plan on its own once it passes 100 orders in a month, and unlocking the missing features in Tidio and Discounty would need paid add-ons or plans.

06
After the switch

How the store works after the switch

A side-by-side look at each part of the shopping journey today, and how it works once the three Account Editor Apps are in place, from the first search to the final invoice.

Abandoned cartsCart recovery
Today

When a shopper leaves items in the cart, there is no automatic follow-up, so many planned orders are never finished.

After the switch

Custom recovery emails in the Color Blaze voice and friendly chat reminders bring shoppers back to complete their order, with timing and quiet hours set by the team.

UpsellsOrder value
Today

One upsell is offered in the cart, so most shoppers only see the products they came for.

After the switch

AI product picks, matching bundles and unlimited offers work together in the cart and chat, helping organisers add the extras their event needs.

Shopper questionsSupport
Today

Questions about quantities, colours and delivery dates are answered by the team during working hours.

After the switch

The AI chatbot answers instantly, day and night, with real products and an add-to-cart button, and hands over to the team whenever a person is needed.

OffersDiscounts
Today

One tiered offer is available and it only appears at checkout, after shoppers have chosen how much to buy.

After the switch

Unlimited offers such as Buy More Save More, Buy One Get One and free gifts appear in the cart with a rewards bar, while shoppers are still deciding.

Product discoverySearch
Today

Shoppers search by exact words and can sort collections, but cannot filter a large range.

After the switch

AI-powered instant search fixes typos, understands everyday phrases and adds smart filters by colour, size and pack type.

Invoices & ordersDocuments
Today

Invoices, packing slips and refund documents are created in a separate paid app, which also emails PDF invoices to customers.

After the switch

Branded invoices, packing slips, credit notes and automatic PDF emails come from the same app as order editing, so shoppers can also fix their own orders before the event.

Summary

Fewer apps, every feature kept, and room to grow

Moving from six tools to three Account Editor Apps keeps every feature Color Blaze uses today, including the Event Date field, the Buy More Save offer, branded invoices and automatic invoice emails. It removes the order cap that raises the cart bill, brings ready-to-use cart tools, and adds AI answers, smart search, live support and self-service order editing, all managed in one place.

Thank you for the opportunity to review the Color Blaze store.

What this shows. A shopping assistant that knows the whole Color Blaze catalogue and answers shoppers day and night, with a Smart Cart Drawer, offers and live support built into the same app. It takes over the jobs of four separate tools today, so the cart, the chat, the discounts and the FAQs finally work together.

Why it suits Color Blaze

Most Color Blaze buyers are organisers planning around an event date. They want to know how much powder they need, which colours work together and whether an order will arrive on time. This app answers those questions instantly, shows the right products with an add-to-cart button, and keeps every saving visible in the cart.

Kept from todayCart drawerUpsellsEvent Date & Order NotesAutomatic discountsLive chatBuy More Save MoreFAQs
AI Assistant
01Chatbot Appearance Customization

Pick from 10+ ready templates, including seasonal themes, then set your own colours, fonts and logo. A live preview shows every change before it goes live, with unlimited edits.

AI Assistant
02Chat Home Section Customization

Choose which sections the chat home shows: open order card, quick question buttons, top buttons and message box. Switch each one on or off in a single click.

AI Assistant
03Quick Action Menu Customization

Build the shortcut menu shoppers open from the chat. Group shortcuts like New arrivals, On sale or Track my order, rename them and reorder them any time.

AI Assistant
04Welcome Message & Empty State

Write the first message shoppers read, plus the suggested and example questions under it. Update it in seconds for a sale, a product launch or a new season.

AI Assistant
05Voice, Sound & Notification Settings

Choose from 10+ assistant voices, set click and notification sounds, and decide how alerts look. Every setting has a live preview, so the chat feels polished on day one.

AI Assistant
06AI Product Answers

Shoppers ask in normal words and get real products from the store, each with photo, price and an add-to-cart button. Follow-up questions keep the conversation moving to checkout.

AI Assistant
07Quick Question Buttons

One-tap buttons for the questions shoppers ask most, like order status, returns and shipping times. Most visitors get their answer without typing a single word.

AI Assistant
08One-Click Knowledge Training

Press one button and the assistant learns your products, prices, stock, pages, policies and reviews. Retrain it any time the catalogue or a policy changes.

AI Assistant
09Knowledge Documents Upload

Upload your own files, like size charts, care guides or warranty terms, to teach the assistant things that are not on the website. Answers stay exact and on-policy.

AI Assistant
10Content Gaps

A list of every question the assistant could not answer, ranked by how often shoppers ask it. Add the answer once and the gap is closed for every future chat.

AI Assistant
11FAQ Manager

Write your own questions and answers in one place. The assistant uses them first, so key answers on sizing, shipping and returns are always word-for-word correct.

AI Assistant
12Chat Rules & Instructions

Set rules the assistant follows in every chat, such as tone of voice, topics to avoid and which products to recommend first. It stays on-brand in every conversation.

AI Assistant
13Discount Code Sharing

Choose up to five discount codes the assistant is allowed to share. It offers them only when the moment fits, and never shares a code you have not approved.

AI Assistant
14Offer Bubble

A small pop-up next to the chat button for shoppers who are unsure. It shows how close they are to a reward and suggests one product they can add in a tap.

AI Assistant
15Chat History

Every past conversation is saved for the shopper, so they can pick up where they left off on their next visit. No repeated questions, no lost context.
